$$
{x}^{′}(t)=[\begin{aligned}0 & -2 \\ 2 & 0\end{aligned}]x(t)+[\begin{aligned}2\operatorname{cos}⁡(3t)-\operatorname{sin}⁡(3t) \\ \operatorname{cos}⁡(3t)+2\operatorname{sin}⁡(3t)\end{aligned}],\,x(0)=[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 1\end{aligned}]
$$

Find the missing coefficients in the solution to the initial value problem, shown above.

$x(t)=$

worked_solution:
We are told that the general solution to the system is 

$$
x(t)={c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡(2t) \\ \operatorname{sin}⁡(2t)\end{aligned}]+{c}_{2}[\begin{aligned}-\operatorname{sin}⁡(2t) \\ \operatorname{cos}⁡(2t)\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡(3t)+2\operatorname{sin}⁡(3t) \\ -2\operatorname{cos}⁡(3t)+\operatorname{sin}⁡(3t)\end{aligned}]
$$

where ${c}_{1},{c}_{2}$ are constants that are to be determined. 

Next, we find the values of ${c}_{1}$ and ${c}_{2}.$ Substituting $t=0$ into the general solution, we get the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}x(0) & =[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ {c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡(2\cdot 0) \\ \operatorname{sin}⁡(2\cdot 0)\end{aligned}]+{c}_{2}[\begin{aligned}-\operatorname{sin}⁡(2\cdot 0) \\ \operatorname{cos}⁡(2\cdot 0)\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡(3\cdot 0)+2\operatorname{sin}⁡(3\cdot 0) \\ -2\operatorname{cos}⁡(3\cdot 0)+\operatorname{sin}⁡(3\cdot 0)\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ {c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+{c}_{2}[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{c}_{1}+1 \\ {c}_{2}-2\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 1\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

So, we have the following system of linear equations:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{c}_{1}+1=4 \\ {c}_{2}-2=1\end{aligned}
$$

From the first equation, we get ${c}_{1}=3.$ From the second equation, we have ${c}_{2}=3.$

Therefore, the solution to the initial value problem is

$$
x(t)=3\cdot [\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡(2t) \\ \operatorname{sin}⁡(2t)\end{aligned}]+3\cdot [\begin{aligned}-\operatorname{sin}⁡(2t) \\ \operatorname{cos}⁡(2t)\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡(3t)+2\operatorname{sin}⁡(3t) \\ -2\operatorname{cos}⁡(3t)+\operatorname{sin}⁡(3t)\end{aligned}].
$$
